summary: Official Stoke-on-Trent City Council GIS and HM Land Registry INSPIRE polygon publication were evidenced. The council viewer is thematic and disclaims ownership-boundary use; the official HMLR local-authority download route redirected in a loop. No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified, no sample GeoJSON was retained, and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English discovery queries are recorded in city-3890-stoke-on-trent.json. The local/native-language route was conducted in English because Stoke-on-Trent is in England and no distinct statutory local language applies; it found the council local-search/map pages and HMLR official guidance.
requestOutcomes: The official council Cadcorp viewer returned HTTP 200 and its current HTML/JavaScript configuration was inspected: EPSG:27700, restricted extent, thematic GeognoSIS REST overlay, quicksearch.asmx, and feature-info wiring. The official HMLR INSPIRE download page returned repeated HTTP 302 redirects and no GML. HMLR API documentation indicates account/licence/API-key requirements, so no credentialed request was attempted. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [53.0159155643046, -2.17437344168429] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
The council viewer's property-boundary disclaimer means it is not evidence of legal land ownership or cadastral coverage.
No city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open parcel geometry service.
No parcel geometry, retrieved stable native identity, HMLR feature schema or HMLR feature CRS was captured.
The HMLR download redirect loop and absent direct file are access failures, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
